metas.name: 2026 · Masterplan
metas.description: A master thief enlists two strangers for a Louvre heist targeting the Mona Lisa, then reveals they're his children and siblings who must cooperate to pull off history's greatest art theft.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · The Rivals of Amziah King
metas.description: Amziah King, beekeeper, musician, and anchor of his community, reunites with former foster daughter Kateri after many years apart, and fends off threats to his honey business.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2020 · Deadwater Fell
metas.description: When a seemingly perfect and happy family is murdered by someone they knew and trusted, cracks appear on the surface of a supposedly idyllic community.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2012 · The Body
metas.description: A detective searches for the body of a femme fatale which has gone missing from a morgue.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2018 · Vada Chennai
metas.description: A young carrom player in north Chennai becomes a reluctant participant in a war between two warring gangsters.

metas.name: ★ 4.5 · 2025 · No Parking
metas.description: After a tense parking dispute, Yeon-hee clashes with a mysterious man-only to learn he's a serial killer. Now targeted, she must escape his deadly grip and survive a nightmare that began with one badly parked car.

metas.name: 2026 · Kill Jackie
metas.description: Ex-cocaine dealer Jackie Price lives luxuriously selling art through tax schemes. After 20 years of anonymity, her peaceful life ends when The Seven Demons, elite hitmen, are hired to kill her.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2021 · Professor T
metas.description: Professor Jasper Tempest, a genius Cambridge University criminologist with OCD and an overbearing mother, assists the police in solving crime.

metas.name: 2026 · Anna Pigeon
metas.description: Park ranger Anna Pigeon left city life after personal tragedy. Now she channels her pain into investigating crimes in national parks, determined to solve cases despite any obstacles.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2026 · Jailer 2
metas.description: A retired officer's peaceful life is disrupted when a dangerous criminal organization threatens his family. He must use his skills one final time to protect his loved ones and preserve his legacy.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 1986 · Henry: Portrait of a Serial Killer
metas.description: Arriving in Chicago, Henry moves in with ex-con acquaintance Otis and starts schooling him in the ways of the serial killer.
